create_webhook_listapi: create a webhook by sending a POST request to the WebhookListAPI endpoint with project and URL details
list_webhooks_listapi: list all webhooks for the active organization via the WebhookListAPI GET endpoint with optional project filter
update_webhook_detailapi: update a webhook by sending a PUT request to WebhookAPI with the webhook ID and new configuration
delete_webhook_detailapi: delete a webhook by sending a DELETE request to WebhookAPI with the webhook primary key
get_webhook_infoapi: get available webhook action types and metadata from the WebhookInfoAPI endpoint
